Curriculum vitae

About

Prosthodontist and implantologist focused on full-mouth rehabilitation, aesthetic smile reconstruction, implant prosthodontics, craniofacial prosthetics and temporomandibular disorder management, using digital workflows (intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM and 3D printing).

Education

MDS, Prosthodontics and Crown & Bridge, 2023–2026
A.B. Shetty Memorial Institute of Dental Sciences, Nitte (Deemed to be University), Mangalore

Thesis: effect of inter-implant distance and scan body exposure on the accuracy of intraoral scanners in digital impressions.

BDS, 2016–2022
Himachal Dental College, Sundernagar. Distinction in Pedodontics (final year).

Experience

Postgraduate Clinical Resident, 2023–2026
Department of Prosthodontics and Crown & Bridge, A.B. Shetty Memorial Institute of Dental Sciences. Over 1,000 clinical prosthodontic procedures across fixed, removable, aesthetic and implant work.

Clinical record

  • Removable: 129 prostheses (complete, single, overdenture and cast partial dentures) plus 14 additional (splints, ocular, immediate, guide flange)
  • Fixed: about 878 units, including 253 single crowns, 183 FPD cases (497 units), 4 full-mouth rehabilitations, CAD/CAM zirconia and lithium disilicate restorations
  • Implants: 13 placed, including immediate placements, direct and indirect sinus lifts, a full-mouth implant rehabilitation and an implant-supported overdenture

Skills

  • Fixed prosthodontics: full-mouth rehabilitation, veneers, E-max and zirconia crowns, smile designing
  • Implantology: planning, surgical placement, sinus lifts, screw- and cement-retained crowns, overdentures
  • Digital dentistry: intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM, 3D printing
  • Removable and maxillofacial: complete and cast partial dentures, obturators, ocular prostheses

Presentations

  • “A Matter of Microns: Unveiling the Hidden Boundaries Between Crown and Tooth”, 53rd IPS National Conference, Mumbai, 2025
  • “Factors Affecting Accuracy of Dental Implant Scan Bodies: A Review”, 49th Karnataka State Dental Conference, Mangalore, 2023
  • Posters: 10th KPS Conference, Mysuru, 2024; 27th IPS PG Convention, Gurugram, 2025

Publications

Build Orientation and Dimensional Accuracy in Additively Manufactured Dental Prostheses: A Narrative Review. Pain, Joints, Spine (published). Two further manuscripts on intraoral scanner accuracy are under review.

Memberships

Registered Dental Practitioner (Haryana State Dental Council); Life Member, Indian Prosthodontic Society.
